name: Expense Report
description: An expense report whose global content and confidential reviewer notes live in different scopes, so a read can serve one and withhold the other.

modules.name: expenses
modules.description: Expense operations. Reducers validate domain invariants only; who may approve is decided by the platform auth scope, not in here.

operations.name: SUBMIT_EXPENSE

errors.name: DuplicateExpense
errors.description: An expense with this id already exists

operations.name: APPROVE_EXPENSE
operations.description: Approve a pending expense. The approver is read from the signer context for display; whether they MAY approve is platform policy.

errors.name: ExpenseNotFound
errors.description: No expense exists with this id

modules.name: review
modules.description: The reviewers' own notes, kept in the local scope.

operations.name: ADD_REVIEW_NOTE
operations.description: Record a reviewer's note about an expense.
